added.name: @smthrs/testing
added.reason: Shared bounded explicit-column process-table probes for real-process tests; a separate Node-only subpath keeps browser test hosts independent of child_process.

added.name: @smthrs/canonical
added.reason: Runtime-free entry for the existing exact canonical serializer and errors, used by browser and Worker wire contracts without importing the Effect schema. No digest algorithm or output change; the package tests prove a dependency-free browser bundle.

added.name: @smthrs/platform-node
added.reason: Shared transient process ownership for build commands, model runners, discovery and services. The public wrapper preserves target status, literal pipe IO and native Windows arguments; the private supervisor protocol stays internal. Durable host ledger composition remains in NodeHost.

added.name: @smthrs/canonical
added.reason: Shared bounded JSON admission and encoded-byte accounting used by flow, run-store, and step-cache; explicitly re-exported and documented by canonical. Persistence-specific error vocabulary remains with each caller.

added.name: @smthrs/memory
added.reason: Host-composable memory migration set and installation layer on the shared durable database ladder. NodeControl composes this public set with lower engine/control blocks; SQL schema implementation remains private.

added.name: @smthrs/engine-store
added.reason: Deliberate public revisioned execution observation port, documented in engine-store's observe-executions guide and API reference; reviewed in execution-snapshots.md. Internal SQL readers remain private.

added.name: @smthrs/engine-store
added.reason: Deliberate public bounded revision catch-up port with durable deletion tombstones, documented in engine-store's observe-executions guide and API reference; reviewed in execution-snapshots.md.

added.name: @smthrs/journal
added.reason: Shared versioned engine event schemas and explicit consumer admission, documented in journal's state-event-authority guide; reviewed in state-event-contracts.md. Additive contracts do not cut over existing writers or expose engine projection internals.

added.name: @smthrs/control
added.reason: Host-owned approval authority, distinct from authenticated principal attribution and workflow capability grants; enforced before mutation/replay and at decision commit.

added.name: @smthrs/control
added.reason: Read port from the control plane into a host's trigger store, so Control.list answers the triggers and fires variants; the port lives in control because @smthrs/triggers already depends on it, and layerNone is the typed refusal for a host without a store.

added.name: @smthrs/triggers
added.reason: Adapter that serves the @smthrs/control DispatchReader port from a TriggerStore, so a host composes Control.list triggers and fires over the same store the scheduler writes; the adapter lives here because only this package can read the store.

added.name: @smthrs/engine-store
added.reason: Authoritative owner-fenced merge intent/completion state. Required on the scheduler's database so a stopped attempt and its atomic plan/input extension survive recovery independently of redacted journal projections.

added.name: @smthrs/engine-store
added.reason: Authoritative owner-fenced input observations for durable plan execution; explicitly composed on the run database, separate from approval plans, redacted journal projections and evictable caches.

added.name: @smthrs/plan
added.reason: Shared ready-work priority, aging and capacity policy; deliberately public for execution adapters. Does not execute effects or determine conditional readiness.

added.name: @smthrs/scorers
added.reason: Pure runtime grading contract extracted from testing so published evaluations do not execute a test package; testing delegates with unchanged verdicts and error identity.

added.name: @smthrs/canonical
added.reason: Retains main's safe own-property record operations.

added.name: @smthrs/journal
added.reason: Retains main's generation-aware journal cursor contract.

added.name: @smthrs/kernel
added.reason: Retains main's declared child-process environment policy.

added.name: @smthrs/std
added.reason: Checkpoint input relocation for the supported read and shell flows, including explicit refusal of writes, absolute paths and parent traversal. Covered by Relocate.test.ts against the owning flow input schemas.

added.name: @smthrs/build-cli
added.reason: Declaration-derived target listing and text rendering used by the index command; keeps planning, host state and cache digests out of the committed metadata contract.

added.name: @smthrs/flows
added.reason: Shared durable runtime with injected host and SQL services; NodeRuntime and BunRuntime preserve the same native API over it.

added.name: @smthrs/flows
added.reason: Bun lifecycle and database composition over the shared runtime; imported only through its explicit Bun entrypoint.

added.name: @smthrs/database
added.reason: Explicit Bun SQLite entrypoint that shares migration and write contracts while keeping bun:sqlite outside the Node root import.

added.name: @smthrs/model
added.reason: Provider-neutral context window lookup already exposed by the development manifest and root barrel; publication must expose the same public module to installed consumers.

added.name: @smthrs/engine-store
added.reason: Shared persisted journal event names already exposed by current main; replay consumers use this stable identity vocabulary.

added.name: @smthrs/gateway
added.reason: Bun adapter already exposed by current main for the authenticated gateway; it preserves the same protocol and policy as the Node host.

added.name: @smthrs/control
added.reason: Documented public Health namespace for Effect checks, bounded observation policies, provenance and shared status rollup, re-exported by control/src/index.ts and consumed by gateway. This adds the public contract without exposing private projection state or changing prior runtime entries.

added.name: @smthrs/canonical
added.reason: Existing main export centralizing Effect Schema issue-path formatting used by control validation. Retains the previous validation-path behavior; record the shared entry without changing the original baseline.

added.name: @smthrs/canonical
added.reason: Existing main export for a copied immutable map facade used by filesystem and plugin views. It preserves read semantics without exposing source-map mutation; record the shared entry in the explicit surface audit.

added.name: @smthrs/model
added.reason: Typed questions over JSON state, answered by Jev through the Evaluator service and decoded into probabilities and confidence; the classifier declaration the classify flows are built from.

added.name: @smthrs/model
added.reason: The Jev transport service: the Vercel AI Gateway layer, a scripted layer for tests, and the unavailable layer a host without a key installs.

added.name: @smthrs/std
added.reason: The classify flow: the cell's door to Jev over any JSON state, single or batched, plus curated(classifier) for one classify/<id> flow per declared classifier.

added.name: @smthrs/std
added.reason: The three curated classifiers (triage/relevance, check/verdict, edit/risk) StandardFlows.classify binds by default.

added.name: @smthrs/platform-node
added.reason: The one constructor for the outbound Undici client a Node process should use: it routes through the egress proxy HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY/NO_PROXY name and is the plain pool when they name none. Every host composition installs it instead of NodeHttpClient.layerUndici, whose bare Agent dials every origin directly and is dropped by a default-deny sandbox. A separate subpath keeps it reachable without importing the jj-bearing host bundle.

added.name: @smthrs/plan
added.reason: The one effect envelope model, relocated here from @smthrs/core so a single declaration serves the plan compiler, the flow graph builder and the pattern library.

added.name: @smthrs/plan
added.reason: The one placement model and its annotation key, relocated here from @smthrs/core so the typed directive and the key @smthrs/flow annotates with are the same declaration.

added.name: @smthrs/plan
added.reason: Draft and compile fixtures shared with @smthrs/plan-store, which drives them against the persisted form. The same test-support convention as @smthrs/database's ./test/TestDatabase.

added.name: @smthrs/plan
added.reason: The one cache-policy declaration: the scope vocabulary, the policy schema, the annotation key @smthrs/engine-store reads at dispatch, and the annotator. It was declared twice, in @smthrs/flow and @smthrs/patterns, tied together only by a re-typed identifier string; @smthrs/plan is the package both already depend on. The identifier is unchanged, so every policy already written is still read.

added.name: @smthrs/plan
added.reason: The one bounded-repetition ceiling vocabulary, taken by @smthrs/flow Poll as onTimeout and @smthrs/patterns Loop as onMaxReached. It was the same two literals written out in both packages with no edge between them.

removed.name: @smthrs/integrations
removed.reason: Schema-install implementation lives at src/core/IntegrationCursorMigration.ts, which the export map does not name; Core.Migrations remains public.

removed.name: @smthrs/build-cli
removed.reason: Declaration-only source file; no corresponding emitted runtime module. Preserve the explicit ./effect-resolution JavaScript hook and its declaration.

removed.name: @smthrs/plan
removed.reason: The plan schema moved to @smthrs/plan-store with the store it belongs to, so compiling a plan no longer installs a database. Import @smthrs/plan-store/Migrations.

removed.name: @smthrs/plan
removed.reason: Append-only plan persistence moved to @smthrs/plan-store, so compiling a plan no longer installs a database. Import @smthrs/plan-store/PlanStore.
